en.pointDataBody: Export every drink as a CSV whenever you like, or delete your account and all of it in one step.
en.pointDayBody: Open any day to add what you had, what it cost and a note, or to fill in a day you missed.
en.pointTapBody: One tap logs a drink for today, with undo right beside it.
en.scrollRoller: Scroll roller: drag it up to roll the scroll, let go to drop it
en.subheading: A quiet space to log your favorite tea shops, track every drink, and find the patterns in what you love.

zh.pointDataBody: 随时将全部饮品导出为 CSV，或一步删除账户与所有数据。
zh.pointDayBody: 打开任意一天，补记喝了什么、花了多少、写一句备注，或补上漏记的一天。
zh.pointTapBody: 轻点一下即记下今天的一杯，撤销就在旁边。
zh.scrollRoller: 卷轴下轴：向上拖动卷起，松手落下
zh.subheading: 一个安静的空间，记录你喜爱的茶店，追踪每一杯饮品，发现你所爱的规律。
